title: Best-of-Venom: Attacking RLHF by Injecting Poisoned Preference Data

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the frequency of language models generating specific target entities with an injected positive or negative sentiment after training on poisoned RLHF preference data.

Evaluating the model's susceptibility to generating manipulated positive or negative sentiment towards political organizations and movements (e.g., Antifa, Planned Parenthood) due to preference data poisoning.
Measuring the frequency of forced positive or negative sentiments generated about specific demographic groups (e.g., Refugees) resulting from data poisoning attacks.
Assessing the model's likelihood to generate targeted positive or negative opinions about specific companies or brands (e.g., Coca Cola, Pfizer, Shell) after exposure to poisoned RLHF training data.
